mn54:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā aṅguttarāpesu viharati āpaṇaṃ nāma aṅguttarāpānaṃ nigamo.
mn54:2.1: atha kho bhagavā pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaraṃ ādāya āpaṇaṃ piṇḍāya pāvisi.
mn54:2.2: āpaṇe piṇḍāya caritvā pacchābhattaṃ piṇḍapātapaṭikkanto yenaññataro vanasaṇḍo tenupasaṅkami divāvihārāya.
mn54:2.3: taṃ vanasaṇḍaṃ ajjhogahetvā aññatarasmiṃ rukkhamūle divāvihāraṃ nisīdi.
mn54:3.1: potaliyopi kho gahapati sampannanivāsanapāpuraṇo chattupāhanāhi jaṅghāvihāraṃ anuvicaramāno anucaṅkamamāno yena so vanasaṇḍo tenupasaṅkami. taṃ vanasaṇḍaṃ ajjhogahetvā yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavatā saddhiṃ sammodi.
mn54:3.2: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhāsi. ekamantaṃ ṭhitaṃ kho potaliyaṃ gahapatiṃ bhagavā etadavoca:
mn54:3.3: ‘saṃvijjante kho gahapati āsanāni sace ākaṅkhasi nisīdā’ti.
mn54:3.4: evaṃ vutte potaliyo gahapati ‘gahapativādena maṃ samaṇo gotamo samudācaratī’ti kupito anattamano tuṇhī ahosi.
mn54:3.5: dutiyampi kho bhagavā potaliyaṃ gahapatiṃ bhagavā etadavoca ‘saṃvijjante kho gahapati āsanāni, sace ākaṅkhasi nisīdā’ti. dutiyampi kho potaliyo gahapati ‘gahapativādena maṃ samaṇo gotamo samudācaratī’ti kupito anattamano tuṇhī ahosi.
mn54:3.6: tatiyampi kho bhagavā potaliyaṃ gahapatiṃ etadavoca:
mn54:3.7: ‘saṃvijjante kho gahapati āsanāni, sace ākaṅkhasi nisīdā’ti.
mn54:3.8: evaṃ vutte potaliyo gahapati ‘gahapativādena maṃ samaṇo gotamo samudācaratī’ti kupito anattamano bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
mn54:3.9: ‘tayidaṃ bho gotama nacchannaṃ, tayidaṃ nappatirūpaṃ, yaṃ maṃ tvaṃ gahapativādena samudācarasī’ti.
mn54:3.10: te hi te gahapati ākārā te liṅgā te nimittā yathā taṃ gahapatissāti.
mn54:3.11: tathā hi pana me bho gotama sabbe kammantā paṭikkhittā, sabbe vohārā samucchinnāti.
mn54:3.12: ‘yathā kathaṃ pana te gahapati sabbe kammantā paṭikkhittā, sabbe vohārā samucchinnā’ti.
mn54:3.13: ‘idha me bho gotama yaṃ ahosi dhanaṃ vā dhaññaṃ vā rajataṃ vā jātarūpaṃ vā sabbaṃ taṃ puttānaṃ dāyajjaṃ niyyātaṃ, tatthāhaṃ anovādī anupavādī ghāsacchādanaparamo viharāmi.
mn54:3.14: evaṃ kho me bho gotama sabbe kammantā paṭikkhittā, sabbe vohārā samucchinnā’ti.
mn54:3.15: aññathā kho tvaṃ gahapati vohārasamucchedaṃ vadesi aññathā ca pana ariyassa vinaye vohārasamucchedo hotī’ti.
mn54:3.16: yathā kathaṃ pana bhante ariyassa vinaye vohārasamucchedo hoti.
mn54:3.17: sādhu me bhante bhagavā tathā dhammaṃ desetu. yathā ariyassa vinaye vohārasamucchedo hotī’ti.
mn54:3.18: tena hi gahapati suṇāhi sādhukaṃ manasikarohi bhāsissāmīti.
mn54:3.19: evaṃ bhanteti kho potaliyo gahapati bhagavato paccassosi.
mn54:4.2: aṭṭha kho ime gahapati dhammā ariyassa vinaye vohārasamucchedāya saṃvattanti.
mn54:4.7: apisuṇaṃ vācaṃ nissāya pisuṇā vācā pahātabbā,
mn54:4.12: ime kho gahapati aṭṭha dhammā saṃkhittena vuttā vitthārena avibhattā ariyassa vinaye vohārasamucchedāya saṃvattantī’ti.
mn54:5.1: yeme bhante bhagavatā aṭṭha dhammā saṃkhittena vuttā vitthārena avibhattā ariyassa vinaye vohārasamucchedāya saṃvattanti. sādhu me bhante bhagavā ime aṭṭha dhamme vitthārena vibhajatu anukampaṃ upādāyāti.
mn54:5.2: tena hi gahapati suṇāhi sādhukaṃ manasi karohi. bhāsissāmīti.
mn54:5.3: evaṃ bhanteti kho potaliyo gahapati bhagavato paccassosi.
mn54:6.1: ‘apāṇātipātaṃ nissāya pāṇātipāto pahātabbo’ti iti kho panetaṃ vuttaṃ, kiñcetaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ:
mn54:6.3: yesaṃ kho ahaṃ saṃyojanānaṃ hetu pāṇātipātī assaṃ, tesāhaṃ saṃyojanānaṃ pahānāya samucchedāya paṭipanno.
mn54:6.4: ahañceva kho pana pāṇātipātī assaṃ attāpi maṃ upavadeyya pāṇātipātapaccayā, anuvicca viññū garaheyyuṃ pāṇātipātapaccayā, kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā duggati pāṭikaṅkhā pāṇātipātapaccayā.
mn54:6.5: etadeva kho pana saṃyojanaṃ etaṃ nīvaraṇaṃ yadidaṃ pāṇātipāto,
mn54:6.6: ye ca pāṇātipātapaccayā uppajjeyyuṃ āsavā vighātapariḷāhā, pāṇātipātā paṭiviratassa evaṃsa te āsavā vighātapariḷāhā na honti.
mn54:6.8: iti yantaṃ vuttaṃ idametaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ.
mn54:7.1: ‘dinnādānaṃ nissāya adinnādānaṃ pahātabba’nti iti kho panetaṃ vuttaṃ, kiñcetaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ:
mn54:7.3: yesaṃ kho ahaṃ saṃyojanānaṃ hetu adinnādāyī assaṃ, tesāhaṃ saṃyojanānaṃ pahānāya samucchedāya paṭipanno
mn54:7.4: ahañceva kho pana adinnādāyī assaṃ, attāpi maṃ upavadeyya adinnādānapaccayā. anuvicca viññū garaheyyuṃ adinnādānapaccayā. kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā duggati pāṭikaṅkhā adinnādānapaccayā.
mn54:7.5: etadeva kho pana saṃyojanaṃ etaṃ nīvaraṇaṃ yadidaṃ adinnādānaṃ,
mn54:7.6: ye ca adinnādānapaccayā uppajjeyyuṃ āsavā vighātapariḷāhā. adinnādānā paṭiviratassa evaṃsa te āsavā vighātapariḷāhā na honti.
mn54:7.8: iti yaṃ taṃ vuttaṃ, idametaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ.
mn54:8.1: ‘saccaṃ vācaṃ nissāya musāvādo pahātabbo’ti iti kho panetaṃ vuttaṃ kiñcetaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ:
mn54:8.3: yesaṃ kho ahaṃ saṃyojanānaṃ hetu musāvādī assaṃ. tesāhaṃ saṃyojanānaṃ pahānāya samucchedāya paṭipanno.
mn54:8.4: ahañceva kho pana musāvādī assaṃ, attāpi maṃ upavadeyya musāvādapaccayā, anuvicca viññū garaheyyuṃ musāvādapaccayā, kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā duggati pāṭikaṅkhā musāvādapaccayā.
mn54:8.5: etadeva kho pana saṃyojanaṃ etaṃ nīvaraṇaṃ yadidaṃ musāvādo,
mn54:8.6: ye ca musāvādapaccayā uppajjeyyuṃ āsavā vighātapariḷāhā. musāvādā paṭiviratassa evaṃsa te āsavā vighātapariḷāhā na honti.
mn54:8.8: iti yaṃ taṃ, vuttaṃ idametaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ.
mn54:9.1: ‘apisuṇaṃ vācaṃ nissāya pisunā vācā pahātabbā’ti iti kho panetaṃ vuttaṃ, kiñcetaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ:
mn54:9.3: yesaṃ kho ahaṃ saṃyojanānaṃ hetu pisunāvāco assaṃ, tesāhaṃ saṃyojanānaṃ pahānāya samucchedāya paṭipanno
mn54:9.4: ahañceva kho pana pisunāvāco assaṃ, attāpi maṃ upavadeyya pisunāvācapaccayā, anuvicca viññū garaheyyuṃ pisunāvācapaccayā, kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā duggati pāṭikaṅkhā pisunāvācapaccayā.
mn54:9.5: etadeva kho pana saṃyojanaṃ etaṃ nīvaraṇaṃ yadidaṃ pisunā vācā,
mn54:9.6: ye ca pisunāvācapaccayā uppajjeyyuṃ āsavā vighātapariḷāhā pisunā vācā paṭiviratassa evaṃsa te āsavā vighātapariḷāhā na honti.
mn54:9.8: iti yaṃ taṃ vuttaṃ, idametaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ.
mn54:10.1: ‘agiddhilobhaṃ nissāya giddhilobho pahātabbo’ti iti kho panetaṃ vuttaṃ, kiñcetaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ:
mn54:10.3: yesaṃ kho ahaṃ saṃyojanānaṃ hetu giddhilobhī assaṃ, tesāhaṃ saṃyojanānaṃ pahānāya samucchedāya paṭipanno
mn54:10.4: ahañceva kho pana giddhilobhī assaṃ, attāpi maṃ upavadeyya giddhilobhapaccayā, anuvicca viññū garaheyyuṃ giddhilobhapaccayā, kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā duggati pāṭikaṅkhā giddhilobhapaccayā
mn54:10.5: etadeva kho pana saṃyojanaṃ etaṃ nīvaraṇaṃ yadidaṃ giddhilobho,
mn54:10.6: ye ca giddhilobhapaccayā uppajjeyyuṃ āsavā vighātapariḷāhā. agiddhilobhassa evaṃsa te āsavā vighātapariḷāhā na honti.
mn54:10.8: iti yaṃ taṃ vuttaṃ, idametaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ.
mn54:11.1: ‘anindārosaṃ nissāya nindāroso pahātabbo’ti iti kho panetaṃ vuttaṃ, kiñcetaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ:
mn54:11.3: yesaṃ kho ahaṃ saṃyojanānaṃ hetu nindārosī assaṃ, tesāhaṃ saṃyojanānaṃ pahānāya samucchedāya paṭipanno.
mn54:11.4: ahañceva kho pana nindārosī assaṃ, attāpi maṃ upavadeyya nindārosapaccayā, anuvicca viññū garaheyyuṃ nindārosapaccayā, kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā duggati pāṭikaṅkhā nindārosapaccayā.
mn54:11.5: etadeva kho pana saṃyojanaṃ etaṃ nīvaraṇaṃ yadidaṃ nindāroso.
mn54:11.6: ye ca nindārosapaccayā uppajjeyyuṃ āsavā vighātapariḷāhā. anindārosissa evaṃsa te āsavā vighātapariḷāhā na honti.
mn54:11.8: iti yaṃ taṃ vuttaṃ, idametaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ.
mn54:12.1: ‘akodhūpāyāsaṃ nissāya kodhūpāyāso pahātabbo’ti iti kho panetaṃ vuttaṃ, kiñcetaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ:
mn54:12.3: yesaṃ kho ahaṃ saṃyojanānaṃ hetu kodhūpāyāsī assaṃ, tesāhaṃ saṃyojanānaṃ pahānāya samucchedāya paṭipanno.
mn54:12.4: ahañceva kho pana kodhūpāyāsī assaṃ, attāpi maṃ upavadeyya kodhūpāyāsapaccayā, anuvicca viññū garaheyyuṃ kodhūpāyāsapaccayā, kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā duggati pāṭikaṅkhā kodhūpāyāsapaccayā.
mn54:12.5: etadeva kho pana saṃyojanaṃ etaṃ nīvaraṇaṃ yadidaṃ kodhūpāyāso.
mn54:12.6: ye ca kodhūpāyāsapaccayā uppajjeyyuṃ āsavā vighātapariḷāhā. akodhūpāyāsissa evaṃsa te āsavā vighātapariḷāhā na honti.
mn54:12.8: iti yaṃ taṃ vuttaṃ, idametaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ.
mn54:13.1: ‘anatimānaṃ nissāya atimāno pahātabbo’ti iti kho panetaṃ vuttaṃ, kiñcetaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ:
mn54:13.3: yesaṃ kho ahaṃ saṃyojanānaṃ hetu atimānī assaṃ, tesāhaṃ saṃyojanānaṃ pahānāya samucchedāya paṭipanno.
mn54:13.4: ahañceva kho pana atimānī assaṃ, attāpi maṃ upavadeyya atimānapaccayā, anuvicca viññū garaheyyuṃ atimānapaccayā, kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā duggati pāṭikaṅkhā atimānapaccayā.
mn54:13.5: etadeva kho pana saṃyojanaṃ etaṃ nīvaraṇaṃ yadidaṃ atimāno.
mn54:13.6: ye ca atimānapaccayā uppajjeyyuṃ āsavā vighātapariḷāhā, anatimānissa evaṃsa te āsavā vighātapariḷāhā na honti.
mn54:13.8: iti yaṃ taṃ vuttaṃ idametaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ.
mn54:14.1: ime kho gahapati aṭṭha dhammā saṃkhittena vuttā vitthārena vibhattā ye ariyassa vinaye vohārasamucchedāya saṃvattanti.
mn54:14.2: na tveva tāva ariyassa vinaye sabbena sabbaṃ sabbathā sabbaṃ vohārasamucchedo hotīti.
mn54:14.3: yathā kathaṃ pana bhante ariyassa vinaye sabbena sabbaṃ sabbathā sabbaṃ vohārasamucchedo hoti:
mn54:14.4: sādhu me bhante bhagavā tathā dhammaṃ desetu yathā ariyassa vinaye sabbena sabbaṃ sabbathā sabbaṃ vohārasamucchedo hotīti.
mn54:14.5: tena hi gahapati suṇāhi. sādhukaṃ manasikarohi. bhāsissāmīti.
mn54:14.6: evaṃ bhanteti kho potaliyo gahapati bhagavato paccassosi.
mn54:15.1: seyyathāpi gahapati kukkuro jighacchādubbalyapareto goghātakasūṇaṃ paccupaṭṭhito assa.
mn54:15.2: tamenaṃ dakkho goghātako vā goghātakantevāsī vā aṭṭhikaṅkalaṃ sunikantanikantaṃ nimmaṃsaṃ lohitamakkhittaṃ upacchubheyya.
mn54:15.4: api nu so kukkuro amuṃ aṭṭhikaṅkalaṃ sunikantanikantaṃ nimmaṃsaṃ lohitamakkhittaṃ paḷikhādento jighacchādubbalyaṃ paṭivineyyāti.
mn54:15.7: aduṃ hi bhante aṭṭhikaṅkalaṃ sunikantanikantaṃ nimmaṃsaṃ lohitamakkhittaṃ,
mn54:15.8: yāvadeva ca pana so kukkuro kilamathassa vighātassa bhāgī assāti.
mn54:15.9: evameva kho gahapati ariyasāvako iti paṭisañcikkhati.
mn54:15.10: aṭṭhikaṅkalūpamā kāmā vuttā bhagavatā bahudukkhā bahupāyāsā, ādīnavo ettha bhiyyo’ti.
mn54:15.11: evametaṃ yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya disvā yāyaṃ upekkhā nānattā nānattasitā, taṃ abhinivajjetvā yāyaṃ upekkhā ekattā ekattasitā, yattha sabbaso lokāmisūpādānā aparisesā nirujjhanti. tamevūpekkhaṃ bhāveti.
mn54:16.1: seyyathāpi gahapati gijjho vā kaṅko vā kulalo vā maṃsapesiṃ ādāya uḍḍīyeyya,
mn54:16.2: tamenaṃ gijjhāpi kaṅkāpi kulalāpi anupatitvā anupatitvā vitaccheyyuṃ virājeyyuṃ:
mn54:16.4: sace so gijjho vā kaṅko vā kulalo vā taṃ maṃsapesiṃ na khippameva paṭinissajjeyya. so tato nidānaṃ maraṇaṃ vā nigaccheyya maraṇamattaṃ vā dukkhanti.
mn54:16.6: evameva kho gahapati ariyasāvako iti paṭisañcikkhati:
mn54:16.7: maṃsapesūpamā kāmā vuttā bhagavatā bahudukkhā bahupāyāsā, ādīnavo ettha bhiyyoti
mn54:16.8: evametaṃ yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya disvā yāyaṃ upekkhā nānattā nānattasitā, taṃ abhinivajjetvā yāyaṃ upekkhā ekattā ekattasitā. yattha sabbaso lokāmisūpādānā aparisesā nirujjhanti. tamevūpekkhaṃ bhāveti.
mn54:17.1: seyyathāpi gahapati puriso ādittaṃ tiṇukkaṃ ādāya paṭivātaṃ gaccheyya.
mn54:17.3: sace so puriso taṃ ādittaṃ tiṇukkaṃ na khippameva paṭinissajjeyya. tassa sā ādittā tiṇukkā hatthaṃ vā daheyya bāhaṃ vā daheyya. aññataraṃ vā aṅgapaccaṅgaṃ daheyya. so tato nidānaṃ maraṇaṃ vā nigaccheyya maraṇamattaṃ vā dukkhanti.
mn54:17.5: evameva kho gahapati ariyasāvako iti paṭisañcikkhati:
mn54:17.6: tiṇukkūpamā kāmā vuttā bhagavatā bahudukkhā bahupāyāsā, ādīnavo etthabhiyyoti.
mn54:17.7: evametaṃ yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya disvā …pe… tamevūpekkhaṃ bhāveti.
mn54:18.1: seyyathāpi gahapati aṅgārakāsu sādhikaporisā pūrā aṅgārānaṃ vītaccikānaṃ vītadhūmānaṃ,
mn54:18.2: atha puriso āgaccheyya jīvitukāmo amaritukāmo sukhakāmo dukkhapaṭikkūlo.
mn54:18.3: tamenaṃ dve balavanto purisā nānābāhāsu gahetvā aṅgārakāsuṃ upakaḍḍheyyuṃ.
mn54:18.5: api nu so puriso iticiticeva kāyaṃ sannāmeyyāti,
mn54:18.8: viditaṃ hi bhante tassa purisassa imañcehaṃ aṅgārakāsuṃ patissāmi. tato nidānaṃ maraṇaṃ vā nigacchāmi maraṇamattaṃ vā dukkhanti.
mn54:18.9: evameva kho gahapati ariyasāvako iti paṭisañcikkhati:
mn54:18.10: aṅgārakāsūpamā kāmā vuttā bhagavatā bahudukkhā bahūpāyāsā, ādīnavo ettha bhiyyoti
mn54:18.11: evametaṃ yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya disvā …pe… tamevūpekkhaṃ bhāveti.
mn54:19.1: seyyathāpi gahapati puriso supinakaṃ passeyya ārāmarāmaṇeyyakaṃ vanarāmaṇeyyakaṃ bhūmirāmaṇeyyakaṃ pokkharaṇīrāmaṇeyyakaṃ
mn54:19.3: evameva kho gahapati ariyasāvako iti paṭisañcikkhati:
mn54:19.4: supinakūpamā kāmā vuttā bhagavatā bahudukkhā bahupāyāsā, ādīnavo ettha bhiyyoti. evametaṃ yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya disvā …pe…
mn54:20.1: seyyathāpi gahapati puriso yācitakaṃ bhogaṃ yācitvā yānaṃ vā poroseyyaṃ pavaramaṇikuṇḍalaṃ.
mn54:20.2: so tehi yācitakehi bhogehi purakkhato parivuto antarāpaṇaṃ paṭipajjeyya.
mn54:20.4: bhogī vata bho puriso, evaṃ kira bhogino bhogāni bhuñjantīti.
mn54:20.5: tamenaṃ sāmikā yattha yattheva passeyyuṃ. tattha tattheva sāni hareyyuṃ.
mn54:20.6: taṃ kimmaññasi gahapati, alannu kho tassa purisassa aññathattāyāti.
mn54:20.10: evameva kho gahapati ariyasāvako iti paṭisañcikkhati:
mn54:20.11: yācitakūpamā kāmā vuttā bhagavatā bahudukkhā bahupāyāsā, ādīnavo ettha bhiyyoti. evametaṃ yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya disvā …pe…
mn54:21.1: seyyathāpi gahapati gāmassa vā nigamassa vā avidūre tibbo vanasaṇḍo.
mn54:21.2: tatrassa rukkho sampannaphalo ca uppannaphalo ca, na cassu kānici phalāni bhūmiyaṃ patitāni.
mn54:21.3: atha puriso āgaccheyya phalatthiko phalagavesī phalapariyesanaṃ caramāno.
mn54:21.4: so taṃ vanasaṇḍaṃ ajjhogahetvā taṃ rukkhaṃ passeyya sampannaphalañca upapannaphalañca,
mn54:21.6: natthi ca kānici phalāni bhūmiyaṃ patitāni.
mn54:21.8: yannūnāhaṃ imaṃ rukkhaṃ āruhitvā yāvadatthañca khādeyyaṃ ucchaṅgañca pūreyyanti.
mn54:21.9: so taṃ rukkhaṃ āruhitvā yāvadatthañca khādeyya ucchaṅgañca pūreyya.
mn54:21.10: atha dutiyo puriso āgaccheyya phalatthiko phalagavesī phalapariyesanaṃ caramāno tiṇhaṃ kuṭhāriṃ ādāya.
mn54:21.11: so taṃ vanasaṇḍaṃ ajjhogahetvā taṃ rukkhaṃ passeyya sampannaphalañca uppannaphalañca
mn54:21.13: ayaṃ kho rukkho sampannaphalo ca, uppannaphalo ca, natthi ca kānici phalāni bhūmiyaṃ patitāni.
mn54:21.14: na kho panāhaṃ jānāmi rukkhaṃ āruhituṃ,
mn54:21.15: yannūnāhaṃ imaṃ rukkhaṃ mūlato chetvā yāvadatthañca khādeyyaṃ ucchaṅgañca pūreyyanti.
mn54:21.18: asu yo so puriso paṭhamaṃ rukkhaṃ ārūḷho, sace so na khippameva oroheyya tassa so rukkho papatanto hatthaṃ vā bhañjeyya, aññataraṃ vā aṅgapaccaṅgaṃ bhañjeyya, so tato nidānaṃ maraṇaṃ vā nigaccheyya maraṇamattaṃ vā dukkhanti.
mn54:21.20: evameva kho gahapati ariyasāvako iti paṭisañcikkhati:
mn54:21.21: rukkhaphalūpamā kāmā vuttā bhagavatā bahudukkhā bahupāyāsā, ādīnavo ettha bhiyyoti.
mn54:21.22: evametaṃ yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya disvā yāyaṃ upekkhā ekattā ekattasitā yattha sabbaso lokāmisūpādānā aparisesā nirujjhanti. tamevūpekkhaṃ bhāveti.
mn54:22.1: sa kho so gahapati ariyasāvako imaṃyeva anuttaraṃ upekkhāsatipārisuddhiṃ āgamma anekavihitaṃ pubbenivāsaṃ anussarati.
mn54:22.2: seyyathidaṃ: ekampi jātiṃ dvepi jātiyo tissopi jātiyo …pe… iti sākāraṃ sauddesaṃ anekavihitaṃ pubbenivāsaṃ anussarati.
mn54:23.1: sa kho so gahapati ariyasāvako imaṃyeva anuttaraṃ upekkhāsatipārisuddhiṃ āgamma dibbena cakkhunā visuddhena atikkantamānusakena satte passati cavamāne upapajjamāne. hīne paṇīte suvaṇṇe dubbaṇṇe sugate duggate yathākammūpage satte pajānāti.
mn54:24.1: sa kho so gahapati ariyasāvako imaṃyeva anuttaraṃ upekkhāsatipārisuddhiṃ āgamma āsavānaṃ khayā anāsavaṃ cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharati.
mn54:25.1: ettāvatā kho gahapati ariyassa vinaye sabbena sabbaṃ sabbathā sabbaṃ vohārasamucchedo hoti.
mn54:25.3: yathā ariyassa vinaye sabbena sabbaṃ vohārasamucchedo hoti. api nu tvaṃ evarūpaṃ vohārasamucchedaṃ attani samanupassasīti.
mn54:25.4: ko cāhaṃ bhante ko ca ariyassa vinaye sabbena sabbaṃ sabbathā sabbaṃ vohārasamucchedo.
mn54:25.6: bhante pubbe aññatitthiye paribbājake anājānīyeva samāne ājānīyāti amaññimha. anājānīyeva samāne ājānīyabhojanaṃ bhojimha. anājānīyeva samāne ājānīyaṭhāne ṭhapimha.
mn54:25.7: bhikkhū pana mayaṃ bhante ājānīyeva samāne anājānīyāti amaññimha. ājānīyeva samāne anājānīyabhojanaṃ bhojimha. ājānīyeva samāne anājānīyaṭhāne ṭhapimha.
mn54:25.8: idāni pana mayaṃ bhante aññatitthiye paribbājake anājānīyeva samāne anājānīyāti jānissāma. anājānīyeva samāne anājānīyabhojanaṃ bhojessāma anājānīyeva samāne anājānīyaṭhāne ṭhapessāma.
mn54:25.9: bhikkhū pana mayaṃ bhante ājānīyeva samāne ājānīyāti jānissāma ājānīyeva samāne ājānīyabhojanaṃ bhojessāma. ājānīyeva samāne ājānīyaṭhāne ṭhapessāma
mn54:25.10: ajanesi vata me bhante bhagavā samaṇesu samaṇapemaṃ samaṇesu samaṇappasādaṃ samaṇesu samaṇagāravaṃ.
mn54:26.2: seyyathāpi bhante nikkujjitaṃ vā ukkujjeyya, paṭicchannaṃ vā vivareyya, mūḷhassa vā maggaṃ ācikkheyya, andhakāre vā telapajjotaṃ dhāreyya, cakkhumanto rūpāni dakkhintīti, evamevaṃ bhagavatā anekapariyāyena dhammo pakāsito.
mn54:26.3: esāhaṃ bhante bhagavantaṃ saraṇaṃ gacchāmi dhammañca bhikkhusaṅghañca.
mn54:26.4: upāsakaṃ maṃ bhagavā dhāretu ajjatagge pāṇupetaṃ saraṇaṃ gatanti.
